options.content:
PSI
Compares reference and current distributions. Higher values indicate a larger distribution shift.
Mean z-score
Measures the shift in the numeric feature mean relative to the reference standard deviation.
Unseen category rate
Share of current observations belonging to categories absent from the reference data.
Missing rate
Share of missing values in the current analysis window.
Cardinality ratio
Ratio of current unique values to reference unique values.
Cramér’s V
Association between dataset origin and category distribution. Higher values indicate a stronger shift.
● Warning    ● Critical    — Not applicable to this feature type

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  drift_metric_threshold{metric="psi", level="warning"},
  "color", "yellow", "level", "warning"
)
